name: Royal Casino
description: Royal Casino is Casino with picture cards having numerical values: Jacks 11, Queens 12, Kings 13, Aces 1 or 14. Players capture cards from a layout by matching number or sum. Dominican version: 4 cards each, 4 face up on table; capture, build, or trail. Target 21. Counter-clockwise.

overview.description: Royal Casino is Casino with picture cards having numerical values: Jacks 11, Queens 12, Kings 13, Aces 1 or 14. Players capture cards from a layout by matching number or sum. Dominican version: 4 cards each, 4 face up on table; capture, build, or trail. Target 21. Counter-clockwise.

history.origins: Casino variant. Royal Casino = Casino with court values. Dominican, Haitian, Tuxedo, Hungarian variants.
history.cultural: Popular in Dominican Republic, Haiti, Hungary.

setup.deck: Standard 52-card pack (French suits). In Royal Casino the court cards have numerical capture values: Jacks 11, Queens 12, Kings 13; number cards use face value; Aces count as 1 or 14 at the player's choice. The same deck is used for capture, building, and trailing as in Casino.
setup.dealing: 4 each; 4 face up on table. Deal 4 more when hands empty.

rules.objective: Capture cards; score points. First to 21 (Dominican) wins.
rules.gameplay: 1. Must play exactly one card. 2. Capture: match loose card or sum; or capture build. 3. Build: combine with table cards; owner must hold matching card. 4. Trail: leave card on table if no match. Cannot trail if played card equals loose card. Owner of build cannot trail. 5. Sweeps (clearing table) score extra.
keyRules: K=13, Q=12, J=11, A=1 or 14. Number cards = face value.
Capture, build, or trail. Owner of build must hold matching card.
Cannot trail when played card matches loose card. Target 21.

tips: Near 21, only certain scoring categories count: at 18 only most cards; at 19 only 10 of Diamonds; at 20 only most spades.
Control builds; avoid leaving sweeps for the opponent. Owner of a build cannot trail.
